LanguageData.RR_Bond_Inspect: Company bearer bond. Face value {0} credits.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_Description: A company bearer bond with a face value of {0} credits. Whoever holds it owns it, so it can be hauled, stored, stolen and burned like any other object. Bank it at a designated credit beacon to put the credits back into the company account; the bond is consumed when it is banked.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_PrintUnfunded: The company account cannot cover a {0}-credit bond.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_InvalidDenomination: That is not a company bond denomination.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_Unfunded: The company account does not hold that much.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_BelowSmallest: That is less than the smallest bond denomination.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_NoMap: No map to place bonds on.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_NoneInRange: No company bonds are within the beacon's range.
LanguageData.RR_CreditBeacon_DesignateDesc: Treat this trade beacon as a company credit beacon. It will report the face value of every company bond within its range, and can bank them into the company account. Its ordinary trade behaviour is unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_CreditBeacon_BankDesc: Bank every company bond within range into the company account. {0} credits are in range. The bonds are consumed.
